DisabledTests.*SplitHandshakeRecords*: handshake messages fragmented across records are not yet reassembled (known gap, tracked)
DisabledTests.Basic-Client-TLS-Sync*: TLS 1.2 session resumption is not implemented by design (resumption is 1.3-only)
DisabledTests.Basic-Client-NoTicket-TLS-Sync*: TLS 1.2 session resumption is not implemented by design (resumption is 1.3-only)
DisabledTests.Basic-Client-RenewTicket*: TLS 1.2 session resumption is not implemented by design (resumption is 1.3-only)
DisabledTests.Basic-Server-RSA-TLS*: static RSA key exchange is refused by design (ECDHE-only fallback)
DisabledTests.*-TLS1: TLS 1.0 is not supported by design (the stack's floor is 1.2)
DisabledTests.*-TLS11: TLS 1.1 is not supported by design (the stack's floor is 1.2)
DisabledTests.TrailingMessageData-CertificateRequest-T: the 1.2 client refuses client-certificate authentication before parsing the request body, so the decode error the test expects is never reached
DisabledTests.RSAKeyUsage-Client-WantEncipherment-*: static RSA key exchange is refused by design, so an encipherment-only certificate never gets far enough to be judged
DisabledTests.Resume-Server-OmitAllPSKsOnSecondClientH: a second ClientHello only follows a HelloRetryRequest, which this stack does not negotiate
DisabledTests.ResumeTLS12SessionID-TLS13: TLS 1.2 session-id resumption is not implemented by design
